description: Fork of exp273 (dual-stream E=64, residual_lut soft NAP=6 tph=1024 -> 1.6807 @ 8K). Change ONLY residual_lut: NAP 6 -> 8, tph 1024 -> 256, backward soft -> multi-alt n_alt=3 (mirrors v_lut's recipe at NAP=8; soft@NAP=8 blows memory per exp265 comment). Param count unchanged (256*2^8*384 = 1024*2^6*384). Bandwidth on residual_lut drops 4x: 12.58 -> 3.15 Mbits/tok/layer; total LUT bandwidth 131 -> 75 Mbits/tok. Tests whether wider tables (256 vs 64 entries per table) at lower density (256 vs 1024 tables) help, while staying at exp265's NAP=8/multi-alt convention. Comparator: exp273=1.6807 at same E=64.
